newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo Sept U.S. car sales up 1.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Volvo Sept U.S. car sales up 1.2 pct.

text.p: Swedish automotive group AB Volvo said on Tuesday its car sales in the United States had increased by 1.2 percent to 6,840 vehicles.
Volvo spokesman Ingemar Hesslefors told Reuters sales for the first nine months of the year had fallen by 0.7 percent to 69,073 cars.
"We see all the more clearly that sales volumes of the 850 are increasing and covering what we lost when we stopped selling the 940 this time last year," Hesslefors said.
Sales in Canada fell by 29 percent in September to 471.
